BSE Limited 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Corporate Relationship Department 
The Listing Department, 
25th Floor, Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, 
Exchange Plaza, 
Dalal Street, Fort,

Mumbai - 400 001. 
Mumbai - 400 051. 
BSE Scrip Code: 524000 
NSE Symbol: POONAWALLA 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Subject: 
Audio recording of the Conference Call held on Friday, October 09, 2026 
Reference: 
Regulation 46(2)(oa) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (‘SEBI Listing Regulations’) 
 
This is in continuation of our earlier letter dated September 30, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 
30 and 46(2)(oa) of the SEBI Listing Regulations, as amended, we hereby inform you that the 
audio recording of the Company’s Earnings Conference Call for Q2 FY 2026-27 held on October 
09, 2026 has been made available on the Company’s website. 
 
The audio recording of the Conference Call can be accessed at:-  
 
https://poonawallafincorp.com/audio-play?url=/documents/20121/0/Q2-FY27-Call-Recording.mp3 
 
Kindly take the above intimation on record. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Poonawalla Fincorp Limited 
 
 
 
Shabnum Zaman  
Company Secretary 
ACS-13918 
 
SHABNU
M ZAMAN
Digitally signed 
by SHABNUM 
ZAMAN
